roots=[Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor', Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-command-bus']
chunks=[]
for root in roots:
    if not root.exists(): continue
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        if target in str(p) and p.is_file():
            try: chunks.append(p.read_text(errors='replace'))
            except Exception: pass
raw='\n'.join(chunks)
